Instead of handling the situation professionally, the staff escalated it unnecessarily, raised their voices, and started recording videos of us without consent. No customer deserves to be humiliated, shouted at, or filmed simply for being inside a store. This behaviour reflects poor training, misuse of authority, and complete disregard for basic decency.

I have video evidence of the incident. I strongly urge management to take this seriously. Until then, I would not recommend this store to anyone who values respectful treatment.
